exercises.question: Which sentence means "Had I been in Lima on 28 April 2011, I would have seen the signing"?
options: Hubiera estado en Lima el 28 de abril de 2011, habría visto la firma.
Hubiera estado en Lima el 28 de abril de 2011, habré visto la firma.
Estuve en Lima el 28 de abril de 2011, habría visto la firma.

exercises.sentence: Hubiéramos viajado a Lima en abril de 2011, __ visto a los presidentes de los cuatro países.
exercises.english: Had we travelled to Lima in April 2011, we would have seen the presidents of the four countries.

exercises.question: Which four countries founded the Pacific Alliance in 2011, according to the text?
